name: Vercel AI Gateway
summary: Managed Vercel gateway for calling AI models from any infrastructure, with centralized credentials, request logs, spend budgets, routing and provider failover.
description: No markup or platform fee on tokens, including BYOK: you pay provider list price from prepaid AI Gateway Credits. Every team gets a monthly free credit limited to a subset of models with lower rate limits; buying credits moves the team to the paid tier.
